instruction: Please help me install the Python extension in VS Code.

metadata.explanation: Task requires installing the Python extension (ms-python.python) in VS Code. Evaluator verifies installation by checking if 'code --list-extensions' output contains the extension ID. Uses existing is_extension_installed metric.

llm_judge_reasons: Command array syntax is incorrect for shell operations - pipe operator '|' and 'grep' command in array form will not work without shell=True
The command array ['code', '--list-extensions', '|', 'grep', 'ms-python.python'] will treat '|' and 'grep' as literal arguments to 'code' command, not as shell operators
The get_vm_command_line function uses shell=False by default (general.py:12), which means shell operators won't be interpreted
This will cause command execution to fail at runtime, preventing correct verification of the extension installation
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Option 1: Change command to a single string and ensure shell=True is set: {"command": "code --list-extensions | grep ms-python.python", "shell": true}

Option 2 (Recommended): Simplify to just ['code', '--list-extensions'] without grep, and rely on the is_extension_installed metric to check if output contains 'ms-python.python' - the metric already does this check
Option 3: Use shell-compatible command format as a single string in the command array if the API supports it
